mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may increase isoniazid neurotoxicity risk, and isoniazid may inhibit furosemide metabolism through CYP450 enzymes.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or supplementation; assess for peripheral neuropathy symptoms during concurrent use.
